note: Questions the bot asks one at a time, like a doctor would. 'type' tells the frontend which control to show. Every question is skippable except the first. The red-flag check runs after EVERY answer.

questions.text: How long has this been going on?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it? (1 is barely noticeable, 10 is the worst you can imagine)
Is it getting better, staying the same, or getting worse?
Are you also having any of these?
How old are you (or the person who is unwell)?
Is the patient male or female?
Is there any chance of pregnancy?
Do you have any long-term health conditions? (for example diabetes or high blood pressure)
Do you have any allergies, especially to medicines?
Are you taking any medicines right now?

urgency_levels.label: Emergency
urgency_levels.meaning: Possible threat to life. Show the emergency message only.

urgency_levels.label: See a doctor soon
urgency_levels.meaning: Should be seen today or within a day.

urgency_levels.label: Book an appointment
urgency_levels.meaning: Can be seen within a few days.

urgency_levels.label: Self-care
urgency_levels.meaning: Mild. General care advice and when to see a doctor.
